description: This file defines the AttributeBag class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically in the Core DTO (Data Transfer Object) namespace. The class acts as a container for key-value parameters, providing methods for managing attributes such as adding, replacing, retrieving, and removing parameters, as well as iterable and countable functionalities.

classes.name: AttributeBag
classes.description: A class that encapsulates a set of parameters (attributes) with methods to add, retrieve, replace, and remove attributes, and supports iteration and counting.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the AttributeBag with an optional array of parameters.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Returns all parameters stored in the AttributeBag.

methods.name: keys
methods.description: Returns all keys of the parameters.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Replaces current parameters with a new array.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds or updates parameters by replacing existing ones with provided array.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a key or returns a default value if the key does not exist.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a value for a specific key.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks whether a key exists in the parameters.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a key and its associated value from the parameters.

methods.name: getIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator for the parameters.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of parameters stored.
